note: point_of_sale: two of its nine abolished-verb definitions cleared while auditing the module. `_ensure_access_token` -> `_get_access_token`: it returns the record's bus/portal token, minting one on first use, so it is a lazy getter and not a check (its two remaining callers and the pos_enterprise field default were renamed with it). `_ensure_to_keep_last_preparation_change` -> `_keep_newest_preparation_change`: it decides which of the stored and incoming preparation payloads wins, which is neither an ensure nor a check; the same commit made it single-record, since it mutates one shared `vals` dict and used to `return` out of its own `for record in self`. The seven left in point_of_sale are three `_ensure_`, two `_validate_` and two `_delete_`; the two `_delete_` (delete_opening_control_session, delete_cash_in_out) are public RPC names, so renaming them is a client-side change too.
